findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 890 requests to 175 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

28 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads-twitter.com (X, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), amplitude.com (Amplitude, analytics), analytics.tiktok.com (TikTok, advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising), chartbeat.com (Chartbeat, analytics), chartbeat.net (Chartbeat, analytics), criteo.com (Criteo, advertising).
345 cookies were set by third-party domains (401 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
